messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: Lynx dedicated slice planned for model pin and traffic shift tomorrow 02:55 UTC. Posting preflight checklist for sign-off.
Diego Ruiz: Can we avoid KMS rotation in that window? Customer backup at 02:30-03:30.
Nina Park: Yep no KMS change. This is model pin + traffic routing only.
Marta Lopez: Which model version are we pinning?
Nina Park: Locking to rwd-model-v2.3.1 (int8). Keep v2.4 staged as hot rollback.
Ava Singh: Ramp plan: 3% canary -> 15% after 12m -> 60% after 25m -> 100% after 50m. Health gates on p95 and error rate.
oncall-sre: Gate thresholds noted: p95 <= 360ms, 5xx <= 0.6%. Pager=oncall-sre on breach.
Diego Ruiz: Enable KV prefix caching please (Lynx uses many short prompts).
Nina Park: Enabled: cache_prefix=true, cache_quota=10GB. Added to notes.
Marta Lopez: Rollback rules in runbook: immediate rollback if 5xx > 1% for 5m or p95 > 550ms for 10m or eval regression > 2%.
Ava Singh: fallback target set to rwd-model-v2.2.9 by default. deploy-bot confirm?
deploy-bot: Fallback configured: rwd-model-v2.2.9. Auto-fallback: on_gate_fail -> shift 100% -> notify #eng-oncall.
Nina Park: Add session drain before >10%: tenant-drain --slice=dedicated-lynx --grace=240s.
Marta Lopez: Prime KV cache script ready. Nina please run 15m before canary.
Nina Park: Will run prime job 15m prior. Prime token scoped and stored in vault.
Ava Singh: Add manual hold before final 100% (30m) to review traces.
Nina Park: Manual hold configured at 60% for 30m. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lynx-preflight-4590012345
Diego Ruiz: Security check: no network or KMS change. All good from Sec.
Marta Lopez: Ops approve pending oncall quiet window. @oncall-sre?
oncall-sre: Quiet window clear. Approve.
Nina Park: Requesting final thumbs-ups to proceed. Reply with :white_check_mark: to approve.
Diego Ruiz: :white_check_mark: (ops)
Marta Lopez: :white_check_mark: (release)
oncall-sre: :white_check_mark: (oncall)
Ava Singh: Starting deploy in 20m. deploy-bot queued.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @Ava Singh. Command: `/deploy canary --tenant=lynx --model=rwd-model-v2.3.1 --slice=dedicated-lynx --traffic=3%`
Nina Park: Prime job completed 12m before canary. KV fill ~78%.
deploy-bot: Deploy started at 4590012420. Canary 3% applied. Monitoring started.
deploy-bot: Canary check at 12m: p95=345ms, 5xx=0.2%, cost variance +2%. Gate PASS, ramping to 15%.
Ava Singh: 15% looks stable, proceeding to 60% per plan with manual hold at 60%.
deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 15% at 4590012532. Awaiting further direction.
Nina Park: Moving to 60% now. Manual hold will be observed for 30m.
deploy-bot: Manual ramp to 60% executed at 4590012560. Hold active (30m).
deploy-bot: During hold: p95=352ms, 5xx=0.3%, eval delta +0.4%. Gate PASS.
Marta Lopez: eval-runner shows negligible regression.
oncall-sre: No trace anomalies.
Diego Ruiz: no veto.
Ava Singh: Final shift to 100% in 5m. Last call?
Nina Park: Go ahead.
deploy-bot: Final traffic shift to 100% executed at 4590012600. All slices reporting healthy. Release note: "Lynx dedicated slice pinned to rwd-model-v2.3.1; KV prefix cache enabled; no KMS changes."
Nina Park: Thanks team. I'll file a short post-deploy note and close thread after 3h if stable.
